description: Static seed manifest for the SchemaCompleteness benchmark. Expected namespace and action counts reflect the catalog as of the generated_at date. Re-run the scan subcommand to get live counts.

dimensions.name: param_types_declared
dimensions.description: All parameters have a type field, or action has no parameters

dimensions.name: required_params_marked
dimensions.description: At least one parameter is required:true, or action has no parameters

dimensions.name: planning_signals_present
dimensions.description: planning_signals key exists and is a non-empty list

dimensions.name: skill_routing_present
dimensions.description: skill key exists and is a non-empty string

dimensions.name: output_contract_declared
dimensions.description: output_contract_status is explicitly declared or not_declared

notes: Full scan issues one monolith_discover call per action. Use --max-actions 100 for CI smoke tests. Probe mode loads probe_set.jsonl and checks expected_dimensions pass rates for targeted namespace.action pairs.
